1553303.name: Dwarf's Barrage
1553303.description:
Fires multiple missiles, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
The missiles can be intercepted.

1553305.name: Witch's Gaze
1553305.description:
Fires viral bullets, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
Deals sustained damage if the attack hits.

1553307.description:
Fires viral clots, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Deals sustained damage if the attack hits.
The viral clots can be intercepted.
